description: Optional Bonus hunt mode for printable missions. Venue keys = slug. Presence still enforced by engine.

challenges.text: Find something cool most people walk past without stopping
Match two patterns (stripes, spots, or shells) in different places
Stand still 20 seconds somewhere quiet — what do you hear?
Find something tiny next to something huge

generic.easter_egg: Ask a keeper or staff one question — write the answer on the back

sources: Giants of the Savanna, Giraffe Ridge, Gorilla Trail, Lacerte Family Children's Zoo, African penguin colony (large flock / dive viewing expansion)
dallas-zoo.notes: Researched 2026-08. Prefer less-obvious stops after 1 savanna anchor. Penguins = signature flock; hippo/cheetah/tortoise for second-visit depth. African Shorelines expansion (penguins/flamingos underwater views) underway for later years — keep prompts valid with current colony.

challenges.text: Penguins: watch one dive or zoom in the water for a full 10 seconds
Giants of the Savanna: spot mud, dust, or water play on an elephant (or the ground near them)
Giraffe Ridge: find something taller than the fence line (animal or structure)
Gorilla Trail: can you tell who might be the biggest/silverback energy? Point and say why
Find zebra stripes AND tiger stripes the same day — which looks busier?
Hippo stop: are they mostly underwater, mud, or out? Guess why
Flamingos: count a group of 5 without pointing twice at the same bird
Little kids: roar once at lions, then tip-toe past something sleeping

dallas-zoo.easter_egg: ★ Easter egg: find a ZooNorth sign or map — tell your grown-up one animal that lives that way
dallas-zoo.easter_egg_little: ★ Easter egg: find the Children's Zoo after your hard list — one free play minute
